The space will bring the album's concept to life, recreating a lost-and-found center that doubles as a secret lair for the five members, who turned into “fixers in Seoul.” The pop-up runs Aug. 25 to Sept. 1 in Seoul before heading to Shanghai, Tokyo and Bangkok. The NCT subunit is releasing the album on Aug. 24, featuring five members, as Doyoung and Jungwoo
